steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and lightly grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Mash the banana thoroughly in a large bowl until no lumps remain.
Whisk the plain yogurt, canola oil, and vanilla extract into the mashed banana.
Add the chickpea flour, oat flour, baking powder, and cinnamon to the bowl.
Stir gently until just combined; the batter will be thick.
Divide the batter evenly among the 12 cups, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
Serve slightly warm or at room temperature. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days, or freeze individually for up to 1 month.
